children: Jefferies Financial reported third-quarter 2026 net earnings attributable to common shareholders of $260.6 million on total net revenues of $2.22 billion, delivering diluted earnings per voting common share of $1.08. Return on adjusted tangible shareholders' equity was 13.5% for the quarter and adjusted tangible book value per fully diluted share was $35.21. The board declared a $0.40 quarterly cash dividend and authorized additional share repurchases, buying 1.3 million shares for $70 million in the quarter.
Total net revenues: $2,221,934 (three months ended August 31, 2026).
Net earnings attributable to common shareholders: $260,578 for the quarter; year-to-date $639,666.
Diluted earnings per voting common share: $1.08 for Q3 2026; year-to-date diluted EPS $2.79.
Pre-tax earnings: $351,038 for the quarter; income tax expense $86,976 (effective tax rate 24.8%).
Adjusted tangible book value per fully diluted share: $35.21; book value per common share: $46.55.
Investment Banking net revenues reached $1.33 billion for the quarter, led by record Advisory ($817.8 million) and strong Equity underwriting ($305.5 million).
Capital Markets net revenues were $802.2 million, driven by record Equities net revenues of $626.2 million; Fixed Income net revenues were $176.0 million, reflecting softer market activity.
Asset Management net revenues were $85.6 million for the quarter, with asset management fees and investment return affected by weaker performance in several fund strategies.

Shareholder returns and capital actions: board declared $0.40 quarterly dividend (payable Nov. 25, 2026) and increased buyback authorization to $250 million; repurchased 1.3 million shares in the quarter and 8.3 million year-to-date.

Strategic partnership expansion with SMBC: SMBC increased equity ownership to ~20% and a joint venture in Japan is expected to begin client service in January 2027 to scale wholesale equities and ECM capabilities.
